description: Create, update or delete skills: your procedural memory for recurring tasks. The operations apply atomically — any failure rolls every touched skill back. Ops: create (lands in the profile's skills directory or configured skills.create_dir; must precede that skill's other ops), patch (targeted old_string/new_string fix — preferred), write_file/remove_file (supporting files), delete (sole op only). Existing skills are modified wherever they live. Description: max 60 chars, 'Use when <trigger>. <behavior>.', never the category name (the index shows it). Write lessons, not logs: imperative rule + why, no PR numbers/dates/incident narration, one rule per lesson, references/ named by topic (extend before adding). skill_view() shows format conventions.
name: skill_manage

operations.description: Ordered ops (a single edit is a list of one); each names its target skill (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Each action is its own shape; another action's text slot is invalid.

content.description: Full SKILL.md text (YAML frontmatter + markdown body).

file_path.description: Optional supporting file (write_file's shape); default SKILL.md.

new_string.description: Replacement; empty string deletes the match.

old_string.description: Text to find (same matching semantics as the patch tool).

content.description: Full SKILL.md rewrite (REPLACES the whole file; last resort — read it via skill_view() first).

file_content.description: Full text of the supporting file.

file_path.description: Path RELATIVE to the skill's own directory, e.g. 'references/api.md' — no leading slash, never absolute; first segment references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/.

absorbed_into.description: Curator consolidation only: umbrella skill that absorbed this one (must exist).

reason.description: Structured write rationale — required for create/edit/patch when a skills admission gate is installed (the gate blocks those actions without it). Note: a gated 'create' is staged for review rather than applied to the live tree.

claim_kind.description: Only procedural content is admissible — declarative facts go to notes/graphiti, standing instructions go to memory.

evidence.description: Where the execution evidence lives (turn/tool/result) and why this is a procedure rather than a note or memory entry.

execution_evidence.description: tier-A: mechanical success signal in this session (exit 0, no later error-recovery turns); tier-B: explicit user confirmation; tier-C: LLM judgment only (must also set verified_by).

neighbor_skills_checked.description: Names of existing skills reviewed for overlap (skills_list / skill_view) before deciding this write is novel.
